notes: Toy configuration for adversarial fixture A20 'Second-place collision' (VS2-C audit D7).
One fungible normal domain; a single Trial that awards first=2 AND second=2 (equal award values); optional allocation; winner-take-all group with shared-full ties.

Purpose: when first and second award the same value, a non-tied pair banks equal awards for the Trial. Reconstructing 'shared' from award-value signatures would falsely flag such a pair as a shared first place. The correct per-Trial shared flag comes from the resolver's TrialResult.shared_first (only a genuine first-place tie is shared). Budget (2) and the shared-rate oracle live in the A20 fixture (REQ-9.4).
